name: Fityeház (Hungary)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fityeház: a blue shield with a red and white checky chief, a yellow wavy stripe and a bird, above a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
